prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Atlanta for a dental implant?
competitors_mentioned: Dr. Carlos Castro at Georgia Prosthodontics
engine_stated_criteria: A strong Atlanta starting point is Dr. Evan Grodin
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for everyone—implant care depends on your bone and gum health, whether you need grafting, and whether you’re replacing one tooth or several. **A strong Atlanta starting point is Dr. Evan Grodin**, who is listed as board-certified in both prosthodontics and periodontics—training relevant to both the implant restoration and gum/bone aspects of treatment. His office is at **3280 Howell Mill Rd NW, Suite 327**.

You could also compare **Dr. Carlos Castro at Georgia Prosthodontics** in Buckhead, listed as a board-certified prosthodontist with additional implant-surgery training. These are options to investigate, not a guarantee that either is the right fit.

Before choosing, get **two consultations** and ask who will place the implant and who will make the crown, what imaging and grafting are needed, the full written cost, and what follow-up or warranty is included. Verify credentials and that the proposed plan fits your case; online reviews alone aren’t enough to judge clinical quality.
